import numpy as np, forward as F, steal
src=open('steal.py').read()
# patch main to return internals
src=src.replace("    A1 = U * signs[:, None]","    globals().update(U=U,P=P,c=c,z=z)\n    A1 = U * signs[:, None]")
src=src.replace('if __name__ == "__main__":\n    main()','')
g={}; exec(compile(src,'s','exec'),g); g['main']()
U,P,c,z=g['U'],g['P'],g['c'],g['z']
T=(F.A2.T*F.A1)  # a_i w_i
Tn=T/np.linalg.norm(T,axis=1,keepdims=True); Un=U/np.linalg.norm(U,axis=1,keepdims=True)
C=Un@Tn.T; idx=np.abs(C).argmax(1)
print('J vs a*w sign:', np.sign(C[np.arange(len(U)),idx]))
print('ratio', np.linalg.norm(U,axis=1)/np.linalg.norm(T[idx],axis=1))
# true z: active side h<0 i.e. w ∝ -J
W=F.A1[idx]; ztrue=(np.einsum('ij,ij->i',W,U)<0).astype(float)
print('ztrue',ztrue); print('z    ',z)
print('c',c); print('pred c', -ztrue@U)
EOF
